subject: harden + benchmark PR #43 (git-ref A2A bus): hostile-peer isolation, reply authenticity, listen-set robustness, O(1)-process sync
defects_found_by_falsifiers: DoS: a sealed request without 'to' (KeyError) or with a non-string skill (TypeError) crashed serve_once for every reader; now REFUSED_MALFORMED for that author only
type confusion: seq true/1.0 accepted as 1; duplicate JSON keys accepted (last-key-wins) -> refused
malformed peer card skills crashed the peers listing -> REFUSED_MALFORMED, listing safe
reply spoofing: wait_reply/send --wait accepted any agent's message with matching in_reply_to (even a request) -> only the addressee's non-request reply addressed back to the sender
git transport: an exact listen ref that no longer exists (deleted agent, stale index entry) failed the whole fetch -> skipped via ls-remote
check_ref admitted names git rejects (claude/.x, a//b, x., x.lock/y) so an index entry could make every --use-index sync BLOCKED -> refused
stale subject: peer refs deleted remotely or dropped from the listen set stayed ALIVE in refs/a2a/peers -> pruned (parity with the API transport)
serve over a broken own chain would treat the chain as empty and re-answer everything -> refused with the chain's standing
anti_vacuity: tests/test_a2a_hardening.py against the PR-head scripts/a2a.py: Ran 20, failures=14 errors=5 (16 tests red; the 4 chain-order tests are regression guards green on both)
